_comment: Site-wide settings. Edit, then run: python3 build.py
_siteUrl_help: Final address with https and no trailing slash, e.g. https://prep.1examprep.com. Leave empty until you have one; canonical tags, sitemap.xml and the robots Sitemap line are added only when it is set.
_brand_help: The site's own name. Shown in the header, titles, schema and footer.
_wordmark_help: Header logo text in three parts: before, highlighted (accent colour), after. Keep it short.

fulfillment.name: 1 Exam Prep
fulfillment.note: Orders are processed, shipped and supported by 1 Exam Prep, our fulfillment center.

_fulfillment_help: Who processes and ships orders. Named on product pages, in the footer and in the FAQ.
tagline: Exam prep for every Virginia contractor, tradesman and building official license
_logo_help: Square/landscape image used as the Organization logo and the default social preview. shared/logo.png is generated by build.py from the brand name.
_googleSiteVerification_help: Paste the code from Google Search Console (HTML tag method) to verify the site.
_gtagId_help: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID like G-XXXXXXXXXX. Turns on page views + all button/click events. Free at analytics.google.com.
_gtmId_help: Optional Google Tag Manager container ID like GTM-XXXXXXX, if you prefer to manage tags there.
_metaPixelId_help: Optional Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Pixel ID for ad conversion tracking.
_ga4PropertyId_help: Numeric GA4 property ID (GA4 Admin → Property → Property details). Needed by /admin/ to read reports.
_googleOAuthClientId_help: OAuth client ID (Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → Create OAuth client ID → Web application; add this site's address under Authorized JavaScript origins; enable the Google Analytics Data API). Lets /admin/ sign you in with Google.
_repo_help: GitHub owner/repo, used by /admin/ to show sync runs and recent updates.
_dashboardUrl_help: Address of your site dashboard on Render, e.g. https://site-dashboard.onrender.com. With siteKey set, every page view and click is sent there.
_siteKey_help: The site's tracker key from the dashboard (Settings → Tracker), e.g. sk_…
_launched_help: Date the site went live (YYYY-MM-DD); used as datePublished in the page schema.
_design_help: Which look the site uses: 0 = original, 1 Code Book, 2 Blueprint, 3 Hi-Vis, 4 Commonwealth, 5 Blue Ridge. Compare them at /designs/, or add ?design=N to any page.
